{"code": "import re

# Re-check the revenue column for any hidden characters or non-breaking spaces
# Use a more robust method: check for any non-ASCII or non-printable characters
revenue_str = df_final['revenue']

# Check for non-printable or non-standard whitespace
# Look for non-breaking space (U+00A0), zero-width space, etc.
non_printable_pattern = re.compile(r'[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F\x7F-\x9F]')

# Check each value
non_printable_found = revenue_str.str.contains(non_printable_pattern, na=False)

print(f"Number of values with non-printable characters: {non_printable_found.sum()}")

# If any found, clean them
if non_printable_found.sum() > 0:
    print("Cleaning non-printable characters...")
    revenue_clean = revenue_str.str.replace(non_printable_pattern, '', regex=True)
else:
    revenue_clean = revenue_str

# Now strip whitespace and remove commas
revenue_clean = revenue_clean.str.strip().str.replace(',', '', regex=False)

# Convert to float
revenue_clean = pd.to_numeric(revenue_clean, errors='coerce')

# Fill NaN with 0.00
revenue_clean = revenue_clean.fillna(0.00)

# Update the final DataFrame
df_final['revenue_clean'] = revenue_clean

# Recompute revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel = df_final.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Get max channel and revenue
max_channel = revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
max_revenue = revenue_by_channel.max()

print("Final revenue by channel after cleaning for non-printable chars:")
print(revenue_by_channel)
print(f"Channel with highest revenue: {max_channel} with {max_revenue:.2f}")"}
